description: An oil-painted dim, rainy interior: a black grand piano with open lid by a tall rain-streaked window showing brick London-style rooftops. Crumpled tissues sit on the piano, sheet music and books on the floor. At left a modern turntable with a vinyl record on a wooden cabinet, plus a gold gramophone trophy and horn. A wingback chair and steaming mug by the window. No people, no frame, no legible text.
